title: Retrospective comparative study of radiological image data and specialist medical findings, with results from AI-based diagnostic tools
summary: This study examines the use of multimodal AI models for the automated detection of hand, finger, and wrist fractures using radiographs. The objective is to compare the accuracy of AI models such as Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5. The study is retrospective and uses anonymized radiological image data.
conditions: Fracture at wrist and hand level

interventions.name: This retrospective study analyzes anonymized X-rays of the hand, fingers, and wrist, which were taken as part of routine clinical examinations at the BG Klinikum Bergmannstrost. The images are compared with the corresponding radiological reports to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the AI model

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•	Radiological imaging for fracture assessment of the hand, fingers, or wrist
•	Radiological imaging from 2023 (possibly 2024)
Exclusion criteria:
None
